customMethods.name: linkAssetModes
customMethods.script:
def getNextCode(codeList):	
		if len(codeList or []) == 0: return 1
	
		vals = list(set(range(codeList[len(codeList)-1])[1:]) - set(codeList))
		if len(vals) == 0: nextInt = max(codeList) + 1
		else: nextInt = vals[0]

		return nextInt		
		
	system.perspective.print("linkAssetModes() called")
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	assetId = self.view.params.values.assetIdList[0]
	assetModeSelection = self.view.custom.assetModes.selectedData
	
	if assetId is None: return False
	if len(assetModeSelection) == 0: return False
	
	for item in assetModeSelection:
		self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Linking assetId %s with modeId %s"%(assetId, item['modeId']), "type": "INFO"}
		
		if not item['modeAssetLinkId']: 
			modeCode = item['modeCode'] if item['modeCode'] else getNextCode(list(set([row['modeCode'] for row in system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': assetId, 'showAllmodes': True}) if row['modeCode']])))
			system.kanoa.asset.linkAssetModes([assetId], [item['modeId']], userId, [modeCode])
		elif not item['linkEnabled']: system.kanoa.asset.enableModeAssetLink(item['modeAssetLinkId'], True)
		
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetModes.data")

	return
